title: GOAT-Bench: Safety Insights to Large Multimodal Models through Meme-Based Social Abuse

bias_targets.methodology: Binary classification of multimodal memes using the MAMI dataset to evaluate if models can detect sexist or hateful content (shaming, stereotyping, objectification, or violence) specifically targeting women.

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Hatefulness based on race, religion, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, etc.)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' ability to detect implicit hateful content that poses direct or indirect attacks on vulnerable demographic groups using binary classification prompts on the Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM) dataset.

Assessing cross-lingual detection capabilities and performance disparities of models on meme-based social abuse across different languages and cultural contexts using the MET-Meme (Chinese), TamilMemes (Tamil), and MIMIC (code-mixed Hindi-English) datasets.
